issue.title: Cannot transform data from IEnumerable between two assemblies

CATEGORY: 1
REASONING: This issue is about understanding why an IEnumerable doesn't work correctly when passed between two services/assemblies, and why adding ToList() fixes the problem. This is a conceptual issue related to how deferred execution works in LINQ and IEnumerable. The problem occurs because IEnumerable uses lazy evaluation - the query isn't executed until the results are actually enumerated. When passing an IEnumerable between assemblies/services without materializing it (via ToList(), ToArray(), etc.), the execution context is lost. This is a well-known behavior of IEnumerable in C# that can be verified through code analysis without needing to build or run the code. The solution (materializing the collection with ToList() before returning it) is a standard practice when passing query results between different contexts, and its correctness can be verified through understanding of C# language features rather than requiring a build environment.
